description: This file defines the public interface for platform-specific tasks in the ANGLE project, including function pointers for time, logging, tracing, histogram reporting, and platform method management. It also declares structures and functions for managing platform methods and their interaction with EGL displays.

classes.name: angle::PlatformMethods
classes.description: Structure holding function pointers for platform-specific operations such as time, logging, tracing, and histogram reporting.
